prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In & Sync Your Pets", "Log in to link your desktop pet securely to your account and keep your progress safe.", "Signing in ensures your pet won't disappear when re-launching the app.", "Cloud Sync Enabled", "Existing pet state will be restored automatically upon login."]
1: ["Save Your New Desktop Pet", "Sign in now to claim your adoption certificate and save your companion to the cloud.", "Save & Continue"]
2: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Click and drag your pet on your desktop. Right-click the system tray icon to hide or open settings anytime.", "Right-click tray icon to open menu", "Press spacebar to bring pet to foreground", "Your Companion is Ready!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen."]
3: ["Upload Photo for Custom Pet", "Choose a clear, well-lit photo of your pet for best custom generation results."]
4: ["Choose Your Adoption Journey", "Pick a ready-made companion in 1 minute, or upload photos to create a custom pet.", "Quick Pick (1 min) vs Custom Pet (3 min)"]
5: ["Hatching Your Pet...", "Your companion will appear floating directly on your desktop screen momentarily.", "Tip: Make sure desktop overlay permissions are allowed if prompted."]
6: ["Use clear, front-facing photos with good lighting. Avoid blurry or group shots.", "Best results come from single-subject pet photos."]
7: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is now active on your screen. Right-click the system tray icon to hide, customize, or open settings anytime.", "Start Playing"]
8: ["Choose My Pet", "Skip Intro Story"]
9: ["Having trouble connecting? Click retry to refresh authentication.", "Server Status: Online", "Retry Connection"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions gifts or free extras to incentivize signing in ("claim your adoption certificate").
Suggests skipping a step ("Skip Intro Story").
